name: Click and swap word
what: A sentence slides in from the right and sharpens on a clean page, a small word rises in after it, a cursor glides in, clicks it and drags a soft selection across it, the word turns into another one that grows a little as it arrives, and then everything zooms toward the viewer in a blur and is gone.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f6-f15 the sentence slides in from the right (linear), blurred and faint to sharp; f34-f48 the small word rises in, grey to dark; f50-f66 the cursor glides in from the lower right (decelerating); f77-f84 it clicks (shrinks and returns); f80-f91 the selection is drawn across the word; f102-f122 the word blurs into the new one, which grows to 1.18x; f132-f140 everything zooms (accelerating) with a horizontal blur and is gone; f140-f149 blank

tracks.name: sentence in
tracks.what: slides in from the right, blurred and faint to sharp

tracks.name: word in
tracks.what: the small word rises in under its place, grey to dark

tracks.name: cursor in
tracks.what: glides in from the lower right to the word

tracks.name: click
tracks.what: the cursor shrinks a little and returns

tracks.name: selection
tracks.what: a soft blue box is drawn from the left across the word

tracks.name: swap
tracks.what: the word blurs into the new one, which grows from 0.72x to 1.18x

tracks.name: zoom out
tracks.what: everything zooms toward the viewer with a horizontal blur and is gone

tracks.name: blank
tracks.what: an empty page, so the clip can loop
